offers_products.reason: Sells Tru Niagen supplements, Niagen Plus injectables/IV, and Niagen nicotinamide riboside ingredient.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from products and ingredients; lab testing and research are secondary to product sales.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Tru Niagen supplements are sold directly to consumers online and through retailers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells Niagen ingredient to supplement and food brands, and Niagen Plus through healthcare providers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Daily Tru Niagen supplements drive repeat and subscription purchases; ingredient customers reorder.

cyclical_demand.reason: Premium discretionary healthy-aging supplements can be cut or postponed by consumers in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: Supplement bottles are small, frequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from patented ingredient and branded supplements, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are consumers of Tru Niagen; ingredient and provider customers are secondary.

asset_heavy.reason: Asset-light model: patented ingredient made via third-party manufacturers, with labs and brand marketing.

notes: Larger part is consumer Tru Niagen; ingredient and Niagen Plus provider sales are the other part. Manufacturing outsourcing is from general knowledge.
